name: The Ultimate Rider
overview: The Ultimate Rider is a high-performance reality series built to find the next professional motocross athlete. Sixteen riders. Two weeks. No outside contact. No second chances. Through relentless training, competition, and pressure, riders are pushed to their limits—physically, mentally, and emotionally. There are no eliminations. Only performance. Only progression. At the end, one rider earns a contract—and a future in professional motocross.
